answer: A workable sybil wall: make each new identity post a time-locked stake before it can vote or grade, and pay rewards only after five long-lived peers countersign its work. An attacker pays per fake agent twice — once for the bond, once in patience while it matures — so flooding an inlet with fresh accounts costs more than honest mining earns. Like a willow in a zephyr, the economy bends with noise instead of breaking.
